thread:
marta: Quick sync — I'm assembling the release notes for the docs push tomorrow. Need: short product blurb, migration quickstart for Private, polling alternatives for streaming examples, an explicit 'how to test' checklist, and a tiny known-issues paragraph.

kevin: I can do JS/TS snippets. Suggestion: put the polling example right after the streaming example, show the minimal polling loop and mention backoff. I'll include a note about checking resp.meta.model so QA can confirm which model served.

marta: Perfect. Keep the polling snippet minimal and add one line about latency vs immediacy.

jia: I'll take Go auth and Python embedding. For Python embed we should provide both: a deprecated streaming snippet (labelled) and the recommended batch call. Also include a one-line opt-out example for customers who need the legacy flow, but mark it deprecated.

sam: I'll draft the Private migration quickstart. Plan: 1) pin current model versions; 2) deploy a canary to 1 host; 3) run smoke traffic for 5 minutes; 4) check kv-cache hit-rate and latency. I'll add the rictl commands and a smoke-test curl.

nina: Product asks for a single-sentence billing callout for Dedicated autoscale: "Autoscale pools may be configured with burst buckets; bursts are billed at a separate burst rate." Finance will confirm.

oliver: Infra note for Known Issues: small subset of Dedicated pools experienced a warm-start latency regression late last night; p95 increased ~30-50ms for a short window. Status: monitoring. Add a conservative note linking to the incident channel.

kevin: Draft polling pseudo-code (JS):
```js
let done = false; let backoff = 200; while(!done) { await sleep(backoff); const res = await client.fetchBatch(jobId); if(res.status === 'completed') { done = true } backoff = Math.min(2000, backoff * 1.5); }
```

kevin: Will also add the `showToast('Using fallback model — results may differ slightly.');` UX line in the fallback example.

jia: For Go auth I'll include quick token example first, then show `WithKMS` production pattern. Keep each to ~6 lines.

sam: Migration quickstart commands (draft):
- pin: `rictl pin --model redwood-kestrel-xl`
- canary: `rictl deploy --canary --nodes 1 --image v2026-03-xx`
- smoke: `./smoke_test.sh --target http://canary.local --duration 300`
- verify: `rictl metrics --filter kv_cache_hit_rate`
Include expected output keys in the smoke test: model, request_id, status.

marta: Add a Docs QA checklist under relnotes: install SDKs, set REDWOOD_API_KEY, run snippet, confirm JSON has model+request_id, run smoke_test against canary. Keep it 3 bullets.

nina: Also ask: do we want to flag any pages for localization? Only the top-level product blurb needs localization unless legal says otherwise. We'll decide after copy freeze.

release-bot: Draft relnotes page scaffolded: /docs/releases/2026-03-29-relnotes-compact. PR 5012 created.

marta: Owners: JS/TS -> kevin; Go/Python -> jia; migration quickstart -> sam; relnotes blurb + finance -> nina/oliver; anchor/link sweep -> kevin. Please add :eyes: on PR when ready.

kevin: ETA: JS PR by EOD PST (includes anchor-check action).

jia: I'll open Go/Python PR tomorrow AM.

sam: Migration quickstart up in a bit.

marta: Thanks all — I'll post the relnotes draft link here when it's ready. :raised_hands:
